prompts.nook-r15-a:
Use your built-in image generation/editing tool (image_gen) to edit an image. Do not write code to draw it; use the image editing tool with input images.

Input images (attach both to the edit):
1. EDIT TARGET: goodwatch-webapp/public/prototype-start-lab/scenes/raw/nook-r12-b.png
2. LIGHTING REFERENCE ONLY: goodwatch-webapp/public/prototype-start-lab/scenes/raw/nook-r12-e.png

Edit prompt for the tool:
"Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the first image. Make exactly two changes and keep everything else pixel-identical in position, color and painterly gouache style:
(1) Remove the sleeping golden dog from the sofa completely. The sofa seat where it lay is simply empty and naturally continues the same cream linen upholstery and seat cushions; a slightly dented seat cushion is fine. Keep the three back cushions (navy star, cream floral, rust knit) and the rust knitted throw exactly where they are. Add no animal, person, toy or new object.
(2) Redesign the shelf lighting of BOTH wooden bookcases to match the second image: a warm amber LED strip hidden under the front lip of every shelf board, so each bay has a softly glowing ceiling and a warm gradient washing down its back panel, the glow bright at the top of each bay and fading downwards. Replace the thin bright neon lines on the shelf front edges of the right bookcase with this hidden under-shelf strip style. The left bookcase gets the same strips.
Do NOT change, move, resize or recolor anything else: the books, Blu-ray cases, plants, ceramics, picture, record, boxes, the window, rain, curtains, lamp, side table, rug, floor, navy wall and the camera framing stay exactly as in the first image. The 11 face-out Blu-ray cases on the right bookcase keep their exact positions and sizes, and their cover inserts stay pure flat uniform #FF00FF magenta with NO glow, shading, gradient or texture on them, with their thin dark navy case rims visible. No other magenta anywhere; no near-pure green. No candles, TV, plaid, people, pets, lettering, logos or watermarks. Output exactly 1536x1024 landscape, same dimensions as the first image."

Save the result as PNG, exactly 1536x1024 landscape, to goodwatch-webapp/public/prototype-start-lab/scenes/raw/nook-r15-a.png (create it; overwrite if present). Do not modify any other file. Report the path when done.
